document: The one reviewed refresh of the half race registry (analysis/half-race-registry.json), 2026-11-19: the rule, every join with its evidence (also in the registry), and every candidate group left separate with its reason.
rule: Review of 2026-11-19 (lead request of that day). Candidates: keys whose place and event title are equal under race_registry.grouping_form (case, accents, punctuation, spacing, a trailing year and an edition number set aside). A group is joined only when (1) no year appears under two of its keys, (2) its keys state a place (not empty, not a timing platform: a place part that is a web domain such as datasport.pl is a platform), (3) every key with a dated edition has a dated edition of another key of the group within 45 days of the same day of the year (a key that fails stays its own race), (4) the group does not have two keys of 100 or more keyed runners each with no keyed runner shared. The short-list races were also checked for a second key of the same place by hand; those joins carry the same evidence. A joined race is named by the event title of its latest key with an edition number (and "Annual") removed, from the key whose title has the smallest share of capital letters among those with any (the latest on a tie).
